headline: Meitav Investment House Q3 Revenue Up 24% as AUM Hits NIS 485 Billion
summary: Meitav Investment House reported Q3 2026 revenue rose 24% to NIS 643 million and net profit grew 29% to NIS 148 million, lifting assets under management to NIS 485 billion.
why: Meitav is one of Israel's prominent investment houses, serving as a bellwether for domestic institutional asset management and capital market activity.

impacts.name: Meitav Investment House Ltd
impacts.why: Strong Q3 earnings growth of 29% and record AUM expansion strengthen operational profitability.
